title: Stafford's Conjecture 3.8 for Weyl algebras: Lean 4 formalization
description: Lean 4 formalization of Stafford's Conjecture 3.8 for Weyl algebras over every characteristic-zero field and every rank, including rank zero. For each nonzero d, the main theorem proves the existence of F, R, and S with the ordered identity 1 = dR + FdS. At positive rank, the fixed-source theorem uses a linear symplectic coordinate to the intrinsic Bernstein degree of d. The formal proof proceeds through symplectic monicization, the canonical right-ideal quotient and Euler identity, filtered support estimates, Poisson involutivity, coisotropic geometry, scalar descent, and certificate extraction. Mathlib-only Challenge modules define the main and fixed-source statements independently of their proofs; separate Solution modules prove them. The repository includes a proof map, Comparator configurations and consumer checks. The main solution follows the proof of the manuscript; a second solution proves the same statements along an earlier route. This software is Apache-2.0. Release v1.3.1 pins Lean 4.35.0-rc3, Mathlib c55e6e786f49471c72fbddbec5415808896aec1e, and AlgebraicAnalysis 0.3.3 at bbbbf3fc358ca8100b158cec4cf47f336ab70163 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23104842).
notes: Kernel-checked Lean proof. Every compared theorem depends only on the axioms propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.
